responseText: Greetings, citizens of Verra. Today we celebrate a momentous occasion-- the grand illumination of our cherished cities, Carphin and Sephillion. In honor of this landmark event, we invite you to journey there without delay. In fact, allow me to grant you the swiftest passage possible, Lightgate Travels. Bon Voyage!
